allow: PowerShell(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3001 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object LocalAddress, LocalPort, OwningProcess; Get-Process -Id \(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3001 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty OwningProcess\) -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id, Name, CPU)

PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3001" -TimeoutSec 3 -UseBasicParsing; Write-Host "Status: $\($r.StatusCode\), Length: $\($r.Content.Length\)" } catch { Write-Host "Error: $_" })

PowerShell($body = '{"email":"admin@edtech.com","password":"Admin@123"}'; $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://localhost:9000/api/v1/auth/login" -Method POST -ContentType "application/json" -Body $body; Write-Host "Token: $\($r.access_token.Substring\(0,30\)\)..."; $headers = @{Authorization="Bearer $\($r.access_token\)"}; $me = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://localhost:9000/api/v1/auth/me" -Headers $headers; Write-Host "Role: $\($me.role\)"; Write-Host "Email: $\($me.email\)")

PowerShell($body = '{"identifier":"admin@edtech.com","password":"Admin@123"}'; $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://localhost:9000/api/v1/auth/login" -Method POST -ContentType "application/json" -Body $body -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Host "access_token: $\($r.access_token.Substring\(0,40\)\)..."; $headers = @{Authorization="Bearer $\($r.access_token\)"}; $me = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://localhost:9000/api/v1/auth/me" -Headers $headers; Write-Host "role: $\($me.role\)"; Write-Host "email: $\($me.email\)")

PowerShell($body = '{"identifier":"admin@edtech.com","password":"Admin@123"}'; try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://localhost:3001/api/v1/auth/login" -Method POST -ContentType "application/json" -Body $body; Write-Host "OK: role=$\($r.role\)" } catch { Write-Host "Error $\($_.Exception.Response.StatusCode.value__\): $\($_.ErrorDetails.Message\)" })
